items.Sentence: The facility is an extended aeration wastewater treatment package plant.

The extended aeration treatment system is composed of conveyance piping, lift stations, sewage grinder system, equalization tank, aeration basin, clarifiers, effluent pump station, leachfields and SCADA controls system.
Effluent Storage 70,000 gallon equalization tank when needed
